lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Scoops

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I have a favor to ask of you.
What is it?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: During snack time for the cats at the shelter today,

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: the tuna-flavored treats I put in storage have vanished.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I've got to replenish them,

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: but I'm too lazy.
And where do I come into the picture?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Could you refill the kitty treats for me?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: It's simpurr.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Just look it up on the Talentum Mall homepage.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: They should be the third result when you search for "tuna-flavored".

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: The delivery robot will take care of the rest.
Why can't you do that yourself?
Sounds simple enough.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I can't.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: You don't understand. Once a cat is determined to be lazy,

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: nothing will shake them out of that torpor, even if it's a matter of life and death.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: To be honest, it's taking all my willpower to force myself

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: to send you these messages.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: It is.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Super simple. Nice and easy.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: That's why I'm asking for your help.
Okay, I'll do it.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Meowcellent!

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Now I'm free to lie down and relax.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: To show you my gratitude,

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: you can have one free pass to pet me.
Just one?
What an honor.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: You should consider yourself lucky.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I usually prefer seeking you out.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: If it's the other way around, I can get a bit irritable.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: With this pass, I'm giving you the right to come find me first.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Do you realize how big of a deal that is?
What an honor.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Meow

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I'll leave you to it then.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: You can send the bill to the shelter.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: The address for the shelter will come up if you search for it,

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: so there's no need for me to send it to you.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: There's a nice cardboard box I've got my eye on.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I'm gonna curl up inside that and have a nice cat nap.
Inside a box?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: It was one of the boxes from a previous delivery.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I like the snug feeling I get when I squeeze myself inside of it,

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: so I often use it as a place to sleep.
Is that why you use the shop rated third instead of the first?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Precisely.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: The box is just as important as the treats themselves.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Anyway, I really should get going.
Have a nice rest.
I'll have to find a chance to use Nero's petting pass at some point.
